carts_exactly_one_owner.name: carts_exactly_one_owner
carts_exactly_one_owner.value: ("carts"."user_id" is not null) <> ("carts"."session_id" is not null)

coupon_redemptions_lifecycle_timestamps.name: coupon_redemptions_lifecycle_timestamps
coupon_redemptions_lifecycle_timestamps.value:
("coupon_redemptions"."status" = 'reserved' and "coupon_redemptions"."redeemed_at" is null and "coupon_redemptions"."released_at" is null)
        or ("coupon_redemptions"."status" = 'applied' and "coupon_redemptions"."redeemed_at" is not null and "coupon_redemptions"."released_at" is null)
        or ("coupon_redemptions"."status" = 'released' and "coupon_redemptions"."released_at" is not null)

inventory_reservations_lifecycle.name: inventory_reservations_lifecycle
inventory_reservations_lifecycle.value:
("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'reserved' and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'consumed' and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is null)
        or ("inventory_reservations"."status" = 'released' and "inventory_reservations"."released_at" is not null and "inventory_reservations"."consumed_at" is null)

newsletter_subscriptions_lifecycle.name: newsletter_subscriptions_lifecycle
newsletter_subscriptions_lifecycle.value:
("newsletter_subscriptions"."is_active" = true and "newsletter_subscriptions"."unsubscribed_at" is null)
          or ("newsletter_subscriptions"."is_active" = false and "newsletter_subscriptions"."unsubscribed_at" is not null)

orders_payment_provider_fields.name: orders_payment_provider_fields
orders_payment_provider_fields.value:
"orders"."payment_method" = 'razorpay'
          or ("orders"."razorpay_order_id" is null and "orders"."razorpay_payment_id" is null)

orders_tracking_fields_coherent.name: orders_tracking_fields_coherent
orders_tracking_fields_coherent.value: "orders"."tracking_number" is null or "orders"."carrier" is not null

orders_delivery_after_shipping.name: orders_delivery_after_shipping
orders_delivery_after_shipping.value:
"orders"."delivered_at" is null
          or ("orders"."shipped_at" is not null and "orders"."delivered_at" >= "orders"."shipped_at")
